title: Bessemer steel process
summary: Henry Bessemer patented a way to make steel cheaply by blowing air through molten iron.
why: Cheap steel built railways, ships and skyscrapers.
interchange: American William Kelly was said to have found the process independently in 1851 (disputed)

notes.problem: Place wrong for 1856: source has the process first described at Cheltenham (Aug 1856); Sheffield steelmaking began only from 1858 under licence.
